label: De ente source and underived candidate are one being under unique actual roothood
meaning: Analyst witness-identity composition, attribution deferred. On ONE carrier, grounding profile m and world w: the De ente source n is an actual concrete root at w (ce7edf53). The underived candidate u has no selected ground from an existing concrete candidate at any world, in particular none at w, so u is an actual root at w. UniqueActualRootAt m w (7ab0ddcb) identifies both with its unique root, so u = n and the two bodies hold of one being. All-world underivedness and necessity come from the underived premise; they are NOT derived from De ente roothood at w. The proof uses neither Ontic.Causes nor any identification of the q3 causal relation with m.grounds; the De ente bridges that make n an actual root are inputs of ce7edf53's own producer. No existence, necessity or divine attribute of any being follows unconditionally. See docs/notes/de-ente-esse-source-1628.md#same-witness-identities-for-1731-2026-11-18.
